description: Calculate a court deadline deterministically from cited rules (weekends, legal holidays, short-period and mail-service rules applied). Returns the date, each computation step, and the rule text and source. Always show the user the citation and caveats; this is not legal advice.

county.description: California county slug, to use that superior court's local rules and closures

court.description: Court id for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, or 1dca to 6dca (CA-APP)

service_method.description: How the triggering paper or summons was served, e.g. "mail" (TX), "mail_in_state", "electronic", "substituted" (CA). Omit for personal service.

state.description: Rule-set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-APP, US, or US-BK

trigger_date.description: Trigger date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. date of service or date judgment signed)

name: calculate_deadline
